svg.title: Omega × ASI
svg.desc: Start with five ELI16 executive-summary slides, then all fifteen module responsibilities and the exercised dependency maps before implementation detail. M1 establishes replaceable ports; M1.2 connects real Hive; M2 adds private memory and guarded revision; M3 adds independent STI and bounded inference; M3.1 accounts for delivery and feedback. M4 connects a generated, shareable native inspect result to an isolated real chain and checks its actual post-state effect plus matching deploy-effect finality. M5 adds four Relations operations, an authoritative commit feed and exact-attribute Search. Actual native lookup discovers roots, traverses relations and retrieves payloads without seeded answer references. The lookup, cognition and commitment paths have separate owners. Suggested delivery: 60–65 minutes through slide 54; ten appendices support discussion. Tested source bfb0ec8856c932dc2bcbc05b8949c957da8d72cd; evidence-only descendant 3dc6c1146601a0d0aa8785e61884970ec84a57c6. Presentation changes do not rerun integrations or expand their guarantees.
svg.text: Private lookup, bounded cognition and verified chain commitments
